summary: 21-year-old CU-Boulder woman high on mushrooms was rescued from the Flatirons at Chautauqua Park after a 911 call; ~35 Boulder County Sheriff's deputies and rescue personnel responded; she was found naked and restrained by two companions, was handcuffed, placed in a rescue basket, treated and released at a hospital
notes: UN story opened run 448; date pinned 2013-05-26 (Sunday): UN pub. 2013-06-02 says "last week"; College Fix retelling (opened this run) says "Sunday"; Memorial Day 2013 was May 27, so the preceding Sunday was May 26. Zero Boulder rows 2013-05-24--06-02.
